text.tspan: Policy-as-code: the same rules, checked automatically at every stage
Example rules: no :latest base · non-root USER · no secrets in ENV · no CRITICAL CVEs · signed images only ·
approved registry only · no privileged / hostPath / hostNetwork · runAsNonRoot · readOnlyRootFilesystem · resource limits
Policies live in Git, reviewed and unit-tested (kyverno apply / conftest test). Roll out: Audit → fix / record exceptions with expiry → Enforce.
Kyverno = YAML, can mutate/generate/verify images. Gatekeeper = Rego, same language reused by conftest outside K8s.
OPA, Kyverno, Gatekeeper, Falco, cosign, hadolint are NOT on your resume: describe, don't claim.
